title: Did Not Like
text: Did Not Like. I did not like this drying rack at all. It is very loud when plugged in. It blows room temp air at your clothes, and not very strongly. I don’t think it decreases drying time at all. The arms and things were a pain to set up. It doesn’t fold very small. You can fold the arms down and the wheels in, but it is still the regular height and takes up 4-6” front to back. I just wasn’t a fan of this at all. Also, it isn’t super sturdy. The pieces would come apart every time I moved it.
